_comment: Repositories the integration job checks out that this repository does not
pin as a submodule. Two exist: chiplet-spec, which is the upstream of two
vendored copies and is deliberately not a submodule because nothing here
builds from it, and IHP-Open-ADK-docs, whose requirements file is one of
the places the ecosystem's KLayout version is declared.
They are pinned here for the same reason the submodules are pinned: a
required check that follows a branch head goes red because somebody else
pushed, on a pull request that changed nothing. Bumping a pin is then a
deliberate commit that says which combination was checked, which is what
The floating weekly run ignores these pins and takes the branch heads, so
a pin going stale is visible without being blocking.
